basic_details.offering_entity: Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange (NAWA) & Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Poland
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Polish Public Universities supervised by the Minister of Science and Higher Education (e.g., Warsaw University of Technology, AGH UST Krakow, University of Warsaw, Wroclaw University of Science and Technology)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Exact Sciences, Natural Sciences, Technical Sciences, Agricultural, Forestry, and Veterinary Sciences. Humanities, Medical Sciences, and Arts are excluded.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~300 to 400 scholarships annually across eligible partner countries
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Competitive merit pool open to developing partner countries (typically 5 to 15 Pakistani awardees annually)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Normative period of Master's studies (usually 3 or 4 semesters) plus mandatory 1-year preparatory Polish language and culture course (if Polish-medium chosen)

nationality_requirements: Citizen of eligible partner countries including developing nations and Western Balkans / Eastern Partnership
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Applicants must be at most 35 years old at the time of application submission (cannot turn 36 during the year of application).
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed undergraduate degree (Bachelor's, 16 years of education) completed no earlier than 2 years prior to application call.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum graduation grade equivalent to at least good (dobry / 4.0 out of 5.0 in Polish grading system or ~70% marks / 3.00 CGPA on 4.0 scale).
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Undergraduate degree in STEM, Engineering, Natural Sciences, IT, or Agricultural disciplines matching target Master's specialization.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated within past 2 years or final-semester undergraduate student.
eligibility_requirements.graduation_year_restrictions: Undergraduate degree must have been obtained within the last 2 calendar years prior to the application call.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Academic excellence, thesis research, and technical projects prioritized.

english_proficiency.notes: English B2 certificate required if applying for English-track studies; Polish B1/B2 or commitment to 1-year preparatory course if Polish-track.

eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: Polish language required only if selecting Polish-medium program (1-year prep course provided).
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Equal opportunity; female STEM applicants strongly encouraged.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Must not have previously been awarded a NAWA scholarship at the Master's level.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition fee waiver paid directly to public Polish university for the entire duration of studies.

admission_application_fee.details: Recruitment and application fee is waived or reimbursed under NAWA intergovernmental agreement.

accommodation.details: Guaranteed priority access to university student dormitory (Dom Studencki); rent (~500–900 PLN/mo) paid by student from monthly NAWA allowance.

monthly_stipend.details: 1,700 PLN/month during preparatory course and Master's studies (tax-free, 12 months/year).

airfare.details: International travel expenses to and from Poland are borne by the candidate.

visa_fee.details: National Visa Type D application fee (~€80–90) borne by student; NAWA award letter serves as proof of sponsorship.

health_insurance.details: Compulsory Polish National Health Fund (NFZ - Narodowy Fundusz Zdrowia) voluntary student health insurance (~55 PLN/month) covered or reimbursed.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: University library and laboratory resources provided free of charge.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Access to departmental research grants and Erasmus+ mobility semesters during degree.

travel_transit_allowance.details: One-time initial settlement grant of 500 PLN provided upon registration in Poland.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Multiple institutions: Polish Public Universities supervised by Ministry of Science.
participating_institutions: AGH University of Science and Technology, Krakow
Wrocław University of Science and Technology
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Top 1 to 10 in Poland; top 300-800 QS World University Rankings.
available_majors: Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electronics & Telecommunications, Robotics & Control, Biotechnology, Environmental Engineering, Physics and Applied Mathematics, Chemical Technology
university_and_program_options.program_duration: 24 months (3 or 4 semesters) plus optional 1-year preparatory Polish course
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's degree in corresponding STEM or engineering discipline with high graduation standing.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Warsaw University of Technology and AGH Krakow are the most competitive; regional polytechnics in Wroclaw, Poznan, and Silesia have higher admission success.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Polish public universities have distinct admission portals (IRK/ESK). Secure university conditional offer letter early to maximize NAWA final ranking points.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register an applicant profile on the NAWA ICT electronic platform during the open call window.
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Check call announcement on NAWA website and verify eligibility (March).
2. Create account on NAWA ICT system (programs.nawa.gov.pl).
3. Fill in online application form and upload scanned degree certificates, transcripts, and recommendation letter.
4. Submit electronic application before NAWA deadline (mid-May).
5. Apply for academic admission to target Polish university through its university admissions portal (IRK/ESK).
6. Receive NAWA selection evaluation results in July.
7. Apply for Polish National Type D student visa with NAWA decision letter (August-September).
8. Commence studies or preparatory language course on October 1.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Direct electronic application to NAWA ICT system followed by host university portal registration.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Uploaded directly by applicant as signed PDF on institutional letterhead.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of purpose detailing academic background, justification for study in Poland, and relevance of chosen STEM field to home country economic transformation.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Short study plan and motivation statement (1–2 pages) outlining proposed Master's specialization topic.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Europass CV format detailing education, programming projects, published papers, and internships.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: No centralized NAWA interview; university department may conduct short online verification interview.
application_process_roadmap.application_fee_amount: Free submission on NAWA system; university admission fee (~85 PLN / ~€20) may apply depending on institution.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Undergraduate degree and transcript must be attested by HEC Pakistan and MOFA, followed by legalization/Apostille or consular legalization at Embassy of Poland in Islamabad.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Documents must be translated into Polish by a sworn translator (tłumacz przysięgły) or certified English equivalent.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Valid international passport with at least 18 months validity
Complete transcripts for 16-year education with grading scale
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested by HEC Pakistan and MOFA

required_documents_checklist.specification: 1 reference letter from undergraduate faculty dean or professor on institutional letterhead
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Signed and stamped by professor from Pakistani university

required_documents_checklist.specification: IELTS Academic (6.0+), TOEFL iBT (80+), or official Medium of Instruction certificate
Standard Europass CV detailing academic projects, publications, and skills

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Annual single-intake cycle. Preparatory Polish language year runs October to June before degree commencement.

selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 15% (Final year capstone project, publications, technical awards)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Independent NAWA expert evaluators in mathematical, physical, engineering, and agricultural panels.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Formal eligibility review by NAWA staff -> Substantive evaluation by 2 independent scientific experts -> Compilation of final merit ranking list.

competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Undergraduate STEM graduate with strong mathematics/computing foundation, high graduation standing, and clear study objectives in engineering or data sciences.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of Pakistani institutions: NUST, FAST-NUCES, UET Lahore, COMSATS, and Quaid-i-Azam University.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Ukraine, Belarus, Georgia, Azerbaijan, Uzbekistan, Kazakhstan, Vietnam, Nigeria, Pakistan.

fake_websites_and_scams: Unofficial portals claiming guaranteed NAWA placements or charging processing fees: nawa-poland-portal.org, poland-scholarships.com.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: NAWA application is 100% free of charge. Beware of external agents charging registration or admission fees.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: NAWA does not collaborate with any commercial education recruitment agencies in Pakistan.
itemized_hidden_out_of_pocket_costs: Polish National Visa Type D insurance and application fees (~PKR 35,000)
HEC and MOFA attestation plus consular legalization fees (~PKR 25,000 to 45,000)
Initial 1-month living cushion before first scholarship disbursement (~€400 / ~PKR 125,000)
debunked_myths_and_misconceptions: MYTH: You must know Polish language to apply. (Truth: Master's courses are available in full English, or NAWA provides a fully paid 1-year Polish language preparatory course).
MYTH: NAWA pays for flight tickets. (Truth: Flight travel is strictly self-funded).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Commercial study-abroad agents claim guaranteed NAWA acceptance; NAWA selections are based strictly on merit evaluated by Polish university professors.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Satisfactory academic progress per university study regulations; failing a semester leads to scholarship suspension or termination.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Mandatory attendance at all lectures and laboratory sessions (minimum 80%).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Must pass all semester examinations and submit annual study report to NAWA.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Full legal student work rights in Poland during full-time studies (up to 20 hours/week during semester, 40 hours during vacations) under student visa.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; scholars are eligible for a 9-month post-study job search visa in Poland.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: If the student discontinues studies, is expelled, or fails to take semester exams without medical justification, scholarship must be refunded.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Changing field of study or university requires prior formal written approval from NAWA Director.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Requires formal petition and NAWA approval.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Funding duration strictly limited to standard study duration (3 or 4 semesters); extensions rarely granted except for verified medical emergencies.
